common: Match the art style of the reference image exactly (a whimsical hand-made collage built from cut and torn painted paper, gouache and screen-print textures, paper grain, loose wobbly ink linework, the same warm palette of honey-gold Cotswold stone, cream, sage and olive greens, duck-egg blue sky, mustard, tomato red and teal accents) but create a completely new composition. Soft, even spring morning light. Close, intimate eye-level viewpoint so the buildings, front doors and windows are large and clearly visible. The foreground (paths, lawn, cobbles or flagstones) fills roughly the bottom third of the picture with open, uncluttered ground. A strip of sky with torn-paper clouds at the top. No people, no vehicles, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no litter. Portrait 2:3 composition, full-bleed illustration edge to edge, no border, no frame.

plates.railway-halt: Scene: a tiny country railway halt in the Cotswolds, seen from the platform. A long gently curving platform of worn flagstones with a pale painted edge fills the foreground. A small honey-stone station building with a tall chimney and a panelled front door, a wooden waiting shelter with a scalloped valance canopy painted in chocolate brown and cream, two tall cast-iron platform gas lamps, a wooden platform bench, flower beds and a white picket fence along the back of the platform. A single railway line curves away past a semaphore signal into rolling green hills dotted with sheep. Blossom trees.
plates.high-street: Scene: the high street of a Cotswold village, looking gently uphill along the lane. Honey-stone cottages and little shops with steep stone-slate roofs and tall chimneys line both sides: a post office with a bow window, a tea room with a striped awning, a red telephone kiosk and a red pillar box, empty iron sign brackets on the walls, front doors in different colours, white sash windows, black iron street lamps. A cobbled lane and wide flagstone pavements fill the foreground. Rolling hills and a church tower in the distance.
plates.weavers-row: Scene: a row of steep-roofed seventeenth-century weavers' cottages in honey stone, with little dormer windows, stone-mullioned casement windows and brightly painted front doors, stepping down a lane beside a clear shallow river. A small arched stone footbridge, a wall lantern, a grassy riverbank and a gravel footpath fill the foreground. Ducks on the water, a weeping willow, reeds and water meadows.
plates.old-mill: Scene: an old three-storey honey-stone watermill with a big wooden waterwheel, beside a shallow ford where a country lane splashes through a stream. Stepping stones, a low arched stone packhorse bridge, a mill cottage with a stable door and small windows, a lantern by the mill door, a wooden sluice gate. The lane and the grassy bank fill the foreground. Trees and hills beyond.
plates.bee-and-bramble: Scene: a cosy thatched country pub with honey-stone walls, a rose-covered porch around an oak front door, small leaded windows, an empty iron sign bracket on the wall, a pair of carriage lanterns, wooden picnic tables and benches on a gravel forecourt and a lawn in the foreground, a low dry-stone wall, a hawthorn hedge and a garden gate, hills beyond.
plates.st-aldhelms: Scene: a honey-stone Cotswold parish church with a square crenellated tower and a round blue-and-gold clock face, an arched oak church door in a stone porch, tall arched windows. A flagstone path leads from a wooden lychgate with a stone-tiled roof in the foreground, past two clipped yew trees and a few weathered headstones among daffodils and primroses in the grass, a wooden noticeboard, an iron lamp post and a dry-stone wall.
plates.rose-cottage: Scene: a thatched honey-stone cottage with a green front door under a rose-covered porch and small casement windows, a cottage garden overflowing with hollyhocks, foxgloves and lavender, three white wooden beehives, a little wooden greenhouse, a vegetable patch with bean poles, a washing line between posts, a garden bench, a wooden gate in a picket fence, a brick path through the lawn in the foreground, an old lantern by the door.
